decisions.reason: The online portal is distant from the core business and has no reported results, but it supports the goal of deeper customer collaboration, and the firm's hiring and investment indicate slack to carry an uncertain digital service.
Winning the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024 clearly exceeds aspirations and gives no reason to search for alternatives, so the firm will keep it.
The quarter-pallet display is close to the core offer, has a page of its own, and needs few extra resources, so no shortfall triggers problemistic search.
The counter display is a standard core product with its own page, which fits the display-only focus and is cheap to carry given the firm's slack.
The freestanding information display is close to the established offer and is prominently presented, so the firm keeps it unless results fall clearly below aspirations.
